intro: a software developer with strong focus on producing high quality & impactful digital products
about_p1: I’m Juan Mercedes, a Systems Engineering student specializing in full-stack web development and UI/UX design. I have around 1.5 years of hands-on experience through personal projects.
about_p2: I combine a calm and empathetic attitude with a logical and pragmatic mindset. Many describe me as a balance between empathy and logic; this translates into concrete skills: clear communication, strong teamwork, and high adaptability to design effective solutions for real-world complex problems.
about_p3: My work philosophy: “Make it exist first; then make it better.” I focus on starting with a simple but solid foundation, and then adding value by refining it with details that truly enhance it. This iterative process allows me to work efficiently and deliver high-quality results.
about_p4: In my spare time, you'll find me playing video games, listening to music, or exploring the latest tech trends. I'm always open to new opportunities and collaborations, so feel free to drop me a line.
tech: Here’s a section showcasing the skills I’ve learned and use frequently. These tools and technologies form the foundation of my development process.
project_music_desc: A music app built with performance in mind with a clean & satisfying UI/UX. It lets you create playlists, import songs from local folders, and enjoy an extremely fast playback to listen songs.
project_music_f1: Low-latency playback powered by a Rust backend, enabling efficient audio processing and fast streaming/response times
project_music_f2: Use SQLite for persistent music library (offline access)
project_music_f3: Designed for high performance with a low-memory footprint, optimized resource usage, scalable architecture & integration points for future features.
project_music_f4: Integrated Tag-based search with fast filtering and fuzzy matching to find music for any mood, genre or custom tags in miliseconds.
project_image_desc: An Image Manager app developed to organize, preview, and curate large libraries, featuring a responsive masonry layout that makes browsing thousands of images smooth & visually pleasing.
project_image_f1: Supports multiple formats: (JPG, PNG, JFIF, GIF)
project_image_f2: Create libraries, folders, and move images between collections for intuitive organization
project_image_f3: Optimized with virtualization and lazy thumbnails to keep the visualization of images & UI smooth
project_image_f4: Metadata & tagging support for fast filtering and smart organization
project_productivity_desc: A productivity app that combines a Notion-like editor with a built-in habit tracker and task manager. An all-in-one workflow for notes, habits and task, with a polished, fast UI/UX that’s a pleasure to use.
project_productivity_f1: Notion-style editor with blocks (text, lists, tables) for ideas & content capture.
project_productivity_f2: Integrated habit tracker to monitor daily/weekly routines with streaks and stats.
project_productivity_f3: Task management with deadlines, priorities, tags and recurring tasks.
